title: Delete boxes for emails no longer visible
creator: eparker32
content: Usually when I open mail, there are boxes next to each email that I can click to delete. content: My calnedar is frozen. On the left side is the month of October 2026. I click on the arrow to move to Novemebr or September nothing happens. content: Yandex email account. Messages are constantly being received: “Alert from account [redacted]@yandex.ru: UID fetch message 5 uid 122: failure due to backend error”. title: How can I maintain email formatting during MBOX to PDF conversion?
creator: singhhvaibhav888
content: Maintaining email formatting is important when converting mailbox data into PDF documents. Emails often contain structured information such as sender details, recipient addresses, subject lines, timestamps, hyperlinks, signatures, and formatted message bodies. A basic copy-and-paste method may not preserve all these elements correctly. For example, images may shift positions, hyperlinks may disappear, and message formatting may change during the process. title: BUG su Thunderbird ultima versione Gmail Google Workspace IMAP inoltro posta inviata
creator: Michele_Wisdom
content:
Titolo: Inoltro "in linea" non funziona dalla Posta inviata (Gmail IMAP) — NS_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY in OpenComposeWindow

Ciao a tutti,

su Thunderbird 159 (Windows) con account Gmail in IMAP ho questo problema: l'inoltro "in linea" (inline) dalla cartella Posta inviata non fa nulla — nessuna finestra di composizione, nessun messaggio di errore a video.

Cosa funziona e cosa no: - Inoltro in linea dalla Posta in arrivo: FUNZIONA - Inoltro in linea dalla Posta inviata: NON FUNZIONA (silenzioso) - Inoltro COME ALLEGATO dalla Posta inviata: FUNZIONA

Errore nella Console errori (Ctrl+Shift+J) al click su Inoltra:

Uncaught (in promise) NS_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY: Component returned failure code: 0x8007000e (NS_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY) [nsIMsgComposeService.OpenComposeWindow] 

   ComposeMessage chrome://messenger/content/mailCommands.js:443    _composeMsgByType chrome://messenger/content/mailCommon.js:898

Test già effettuati (tutti senza successo): 1. Proprietà cartella → Ripara cartella 2. Eliminazione manuale dei file .msf della Posta inviata (rigenerati al riavvio) 3. Copiati 5-10 messaggi in una cartella locale di test vuota: il problema persiste 

  (quindi NON è il volume della cartella)

4. Provato sia da pulsante che da menu contestuale

Workaround attuale: impostare "Inoltra messaggi: Come allegato" (Impostazioni → Generali), che funziona correttamente.

Nota: la firma di errore è identica al bug 2036765 (Forwarding/Redirecting fails with NS_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY), ma quello era su Exchange e risulta fixato in 151/152, mentre io lo riscontro su 159 con Gmail IMAP. Potrebbe essere una regressione correlata?

Grazie per l'attenzione. Michele

title: Are calendars supported over Graph API? Contradicting (?) information in wiki and release notes
creator: iyanmv
content:
Hello,

As far as I know, support for the Graph API only includes support for emails. This was clearly explained in the release notes of the first release that included support for this new API. It is also explained in the wiki (https://wiki.mozilla.org/Thunderbird:Microsoft_Graph_API):

"The Graph implementation should support all of the same operations as EWS. Thunderbird Exchange supported features. Calendar is not yet supported."

However, in the latest release notes the two new features are very confusing:

"Linux tray icons indicate unread mail and show its count in the tooltip"

How? I still don't get a tray icon, how would I see the email counter? Are you sure this is for linux and not for windows only? The new tray icon from 154.0 was only for Windows, despite many blog posts wrongly saying this was available in Linux. This is clearly explained here: https://support.mozilla.org/en-US/kb/close-tray-starting-154

"Graph calendars are auto-detected on new account creation"

How? So are calendars supported over Graph? If so, they can only be added when adding a new account? What about previously set up accounts using Graph? This bullet point is so confusing when everywhere else (support articles, wiki linked above, etc.) all clearly say that Graph support does not include yet calendar support.

title: Thunderbird resets and redownloads all my emails everytime I open the program
creator: becky1
content: I am still running Windows 10, but as of yesterday every time I open Thunderbird it resets my settings and spends hours re-downloading every email that I have. It constantly tells me that the connection to the server has failed and that all my passwords are wrong. Nothing is wrong with the server and none of my passwords are incorrect. After about 2 hrs, it completely re-downloads every email (I have multiple accounts) and I can continue to work like nothing was ever wrong in the first place. However, if I close out the program, it starts all over again. It randomly picks an email account and requires that I start from scratch and reset them up. Other times they are there like nothing happened. I have restarted my computer multiple times, it continues to do this.

I cannot find a control or documentation which governs the time zone used by either the Date column or the message date in the right part of the message pane.

title: Thunderbird 153 ESR freezes during POP3 mail retrieval and while idle on Windows 10
creator: kawamtmy
content:
Hello, I am experiencing repeated freezes in Thunderbird 153 ESR on Windows 10. I have been investigating this problem since mid-October 2026, but have not been able to identify the cause. Thunderbird is essential for my daily work, so I would appreciate advice on identifying the cause and restoring stable operation.

1. System environment - PC: dynabook R63/B - OS: Windows 10, 64-bit - Thunderbird: 153.6.0esr, 64-bit - Mail provider: @nifty (Japan) - Incoming mail: POP3 over SSL/TLS, port 995 - Security software: Super Security (Japanese security software) - Mail storage: Local mbox files

2. When the problem started Thunderbird worked reasonably well until September 2026. The freezing problem began around mid-October 2026. Windows Reliability Monitor recorded Thunderbird as "Stopped responding" on October 19, 2026, at 9:48 a.m. This is the earliest recorded incident I have found, although the problem may have started earlier. Thunderbird update history: - September 18: 153.3.1esr - October 1: 153.4.0esr - October 14: 153.5.0esr - October 21: 153.5.1esr - October 28: 153.6.0esr The first recorded freeze occurred after the update to 153.5.0esr. However, I have not established that the update caused the problem.

3. Symptoms Thunderbird becomes unresponsive and usually has to be forcibly terminated. During these freezes, Windows Task Manager often shows Thunderbird using approximately 30–40% CPU, repeatedly around 39–40%. Freezes also occur when Thunderbird is using only about 1.1 GB of memory. On other occasions, memory usage has increased to approximately 2.56 GB. The problem occurs under several different conditions: 1. During manual POP3 mail retrieval. 2. After repeated manual mail retrieval operations. 3. Approximately 30 minutes after a single mail retrieval, even when Thunderbird is left idle. 4. Sometimes after replying to messages or copying messages to other folders. 5. In both normal mode and Troubleshoot Mode. 6. Sometimes during the first mail retrieval after starting Thunderbird. Other Windows applications generally remain responsive when Thunderbird freezes. Restarting Windows sometimes restores normal Thunderbird operation temporarily, but the problem returns.

4. Troubleshooting already performed I have already tried the following: - Reinstalled Thunderbird from the official website. - Created a new Thunderbird test profile. - Disabled extensions. - Disabled hardware acceleration. - Disabled global search and indexing. - Removed all active Thunderbird message filters for testing. - Disabled the anti-spam component of Super Security. - Disabled automatic mail checking and automatic downloading. - Tested manual mail retrieval in Troubleshoot Mode. - Reduced the size of the Inbox from approximately 4.1 GB to 2.4 GB. - Performed a full antivirus scan, which detected no threats. The new profile initially worked, including several successful POP3 retrievals, but the freezing problem later returned. Reinstalling Thunderbird did not resolve the issue. The anti-spam component remains disabled for testing, but the problem continues.

5. Windows error records Windows Reliability Monitor recorded Thunderbird as unresponsive on October 19, 2026, at 9:48 a.m. Windows Event Viewer also recorded an Application Hang, Event ID 1002, on October 30, 2026, at approximately 4:23 a.m. The affected executable was thunderbird.exe, version 153.6.0.0. These records confirm the application hang but do not identify its underlying cause.

6. POP3 communication Earlier POP3 logging confirmed that Thunderbird connected to the @nifty POP3 server and received a CAPA response. However, I have not identified which POP3 or internal Thunderbird operation was active at the exact moment of the freeze. I have not collected a process memory dump.

7. Potentially related Mozilla bug reports I found two reports that may be relevant: - Bug 2080699: POP mail retrieval becomes unresponsive in Thunderbird 153.4.0esr. - Bug 2031744: Freezing potentially related to mail index (.msf) files and background processing. Some symptoms are similar, but I cannot determine whether they have the same underlying cause.

8. Questions I would appreciate advice on the following: 1. Are there known POP3-related freezes or high-CPU problems in Thunderbird 153 ESR, particularly after the October 2026 updates? 2. Could background mail processing, folder maintenance, or mail index files explain a freeze that occurs while Thunderbird is idle? 3. Could interaction with antivirus software or Windows networking components cause these symptoms? 4. Are there diagnostic steps that can help identify the cause without repeatedly freezing Thunderbird or risking existing mail data? 5. Would this information be more appropriate as an additional comment on an existing Bugzilla report or as a separate bug report? I have already spent considerable time testing different configurations. I would prefer to avoid repeating tests that have not helped. I have a backup of my Thunderbird profile and would like to preserve my existing mail data.

Thank you for your assistance.
